caption:
The tongue is more powerful than most people understand 

#usahealth #wellness #chinesemedicineworks #wellnessjourney
transcript: The tongue is more powerful than most people understand. Every word you speak is like planting a seed in the soil of your life. If every day you speak struggle, exhaustion and lack, do not be surprised when those things continue to grow around you. You cannot keep saying, nothing works for me, I am always broke, life is against me, and expect blessings to quietly find their way to your door. Life listens to the language you repeat. So begin to speak like the person you are becoming. Speak favour over your life. Speak alignment. Speak abundance. Speak peace, even when the evidence has not arrived yet. Because words shape the direction of the mind, and the mind quietly shapes the direction of life. When your mouth stops working against your future, your future begins working for you. If your mind has been filled with doubt, stress and negative thoughts, this is exactly why I created the Monks 30 Day Mind Reset. 30 days of small practices that slowly rebuild the way you think, speak and live. If you are ready to reset your mind, the book is waiting for you in the link in my bio.
